messages.subject: Project participation
parts:
Hi. I am a PhD student of the Department of Electronics and Computer Technology of Sumy State University.  Now I am visiting student at University of Toronto in research direction: “Operation Research, Mathematical and Computer Modeling of Information Systems, Financial Engineering”. I am interested in participating in the project: “Improve constraints, usability,  graphics for PortfolioAnalytics”. I think I have required skills for it. I am working on my dissertation “Models Identification in Portfolio Analysis and Risk Management” and I am familiar with the basic techniques used in this field. Also I have good experience in C/C++, finance and optimization Matlab’s packages,  some statistical Stata’s packages, CPLEX and IPOPT. I have a basic knowledge in R, but I think my experience compensated for the gaps in knowledge.

Who can I contact to discuss project proposal?

Thanks.

Looking forward for response.
